campaigns.name: CRKLR - Prospecting Campaign - Daily Budget – V2

notes: Vesu reopened on 8 September 2026 after closing in late April. Meta bookings and CPA come from the conversion (leads) campaign only, which is the only Meta campaign running this week.
The awareness campaign that ran while Vesu was closed stopped on 6 September and carries no cost per booking; last year’s awareness spend is likewise left out of the year-on-year CPA.
The Canton Library opened on 8 September 2026, so there is no year-on-year comparison (the 2025 Vista site was a different restaurant).

Meta = the two Canton campaigns inside the Vista ad account only; legacy Vista campaigns and the earlier lead-gen campaign are excluded. CPA uses the conversions campaign (HK$9,222); the awareness campaign (HK$3,045) optimises to landing page views and carries no cost per booking.

Google spent HK$6,894 this week. The booking conversion action recorded 6 conversions against 1 last week, and a book_now_button_click action recorded 91, but six conversions against 37 GA4 bookings is still not a working import, so Google bookings and CPA are shown as not available and are left out of the bookings, CPA and funnel figures on this view. The paid funnel is Meta only.

notes: All = every venue in this list: Aqua HK, Hutong HK, The Chinese Library, Cantina, Dim Sum Library, Shiro (both sites, with the shared Shiro ad account counted once), Vesu and The Canton Library. That is wider than the dashboard portfolio, which leaves out Vesu and The Canton Library.

Ad spend includes everything. Ad-driven bookings, CPA and the paid funnel leave out The Canton Library’s Google spend (still no verified booking conversion), and CPA leaves out the Canton awareness campaign. Shiro’s shared ad account is counted once in every figure on this All view, including the spend trend.

foot_extra: n/a = not available or not tracked (never a zero). Shiro Pacific Place and Shiro Tai Kwun share one Meta and one Google account.
